task.title: Merge, Rebase, or Cherry-Pick
task.shortdesc: Bring work from another branch or commit into your current branch.

context.p: Choose the approach that fits your needs. See for how merge and rebase differ.

choices.choice:

To replay your commits onto another commit, right-click the target commit in the
view and select , then confirm. This replays all of the current branch's local commits onto that commit. It is not an interactive rebase.If the current branch has already been pushed to a remote, you need to force push after the rebase because the branch history changed.

To copy a single commit onto your branch, right-click it in the
view and select .

info.p: If the operation produces conflicts, resolve them and finish it. See . A rebase is blocked if there are unresolved conflicts or uncommitted changes that would be overwritten.
